title: 63. Can I link directly to a translation of my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: Can I link directly to a translation of my survey.
short_answer: When you send out invitations containing the link or use the link to the published form on the 'Overview' page, by default the link points to the form in the main language.
procedure: You can also redirect respondents directly to a specific translation by using this link:
SurveyAlias with the alias of your survey LC with the appropriate ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. FR for French, DE for German, etc.)
